title: The Innocents Abroad — Volume 02
summary: "The Innocents Abroad — Volume 02" by Mark Twain is part of a travel book published in 1869. This volume continues Twain's humorous chronicle of his five-month voyage aboard the steamship Quaker City through Europe and the Holy Land. With his signature wit, Twain contrasts romantic travel writing with reality, lampooning fellow travelers and questioning historical reverence.
